turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good morning, Orion Shield Insurance, Rahul speaking. How may I help you? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I've just moved house and need to update my address. I'm worried it'll push my premium up, it's already so expensive.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, that must be really stressful. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: David Cohen, 16 February 1964.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's NM5 1LB.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, could you speak up a bit? I'm quite hard of hearing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Of course, I'll speak slowly and clearly. I can also confirm everything in writing afterwards, or arrange a callback with our priority support team if that's easier.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've moved house and need your address updated. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And what's the new address, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 22 Maple Close.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just leave my premium the same? It's only a few streets away.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is my premium going to stay the same?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't confirm how it will affect your price, the system will recalculate it and you'll get it in writing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, we may need to review the details, which can change your price slightly, and any difference is simply worked out for the part of the year that's left.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 1:30]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, I appreciate your patience. The change takes effect straight away and we'll send your updated policy documents within 14 days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Cohen. Someone will get back to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Mr Cohen. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
